description: This file defines the enum StandingInstructionPriority, representing different priority levels for standing instructions in the account domain of the Fineract financial platform.

classes.name: StandingInstructionPriority
classes.description: Enum representing various priorities for standing instructions such as INVALID, URGENT, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW. Contains utility methods to interpret and compare priorities.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer value to the corresponding StandingInstructionPriority enum, defaulting to INVALID if no match is found.

methods.name: hasStateOf
methods.description: Checks if the current priority matches a given priority state.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the priority.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the priority.

methods.name: isHighPriority
methods.description: Checks if the priority is HIGH.

methods.name: isLowPriority
methods.description: Checks if the priority is LOW.

methods.name: isUrgentPriority
methods.description: Checks if the priority is URGENT.

methods.name: isMediumPriority
methods.description: Checks if the priority is MEDIUM.
